capacity_fixture_extension_review.activation: Only SWINGSET_TEST_TMP_RETENTION=failed plus the capacity_disk marker; ordinary and native tests keep the builtin fixture path.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.cleanup: Only after the wrapper finalized and setup,call,teardown reports all passed. Atomically move into a fresh private same-filesystem quarantine, recheck ownership, then rmtree only that private quarantine. Ownership changes retain payload and report a teardown error with its retained path.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.export_requirement: The job exporter must durably copy all retained /tmp/swingset-capacity-* directories, including swingset-capacity-clean-* quarantines, as well as retained pytest payloads, before client exit.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.failure_semantics: Capacity fixtures retain setup/call/teardown failures and SIGINT state. Ordinary builtin fixtures still have the narrower call-failure retention described above.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.ownership: Exact UID,mode,device,inode and private nonce marker. Marker open uses O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK; fstat requires a regular current-UID file and a bounded exact token read, so FIFO/oversized/symlink markers refuse safely.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.placement: A private direct /tmp/swingset-capacity-* parent is created by mkdtemp with mode0700 on the persistent named /tmp volume. Its nonce stays in that parent; tests receive a clean mode0700 child named case. The nonce never enters application state or backup history. Real statfs/free-space checks run unchanged.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.selection: Capacity metadata adds a marker only; it changes no selected node or test assertion.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.source_safety: Child symlinks are unlinked during owned-directory cleanup; the source target stays unchanged. No source, production directory or shared ledger is an allocation target.
capacity_fixture_extension_review.verdict: ACCEPT the explicit persistent capacity-fixture exception with the same bounded harness conditions.

installed_pytest_semantics.application_cleanup: The Postgres test owner finalizer may run after tmp_path cleanup; it uses its separate persistent exact-owner registry and tolerates an absent state marker.
installed_pytest_semantics.factory_lifetime: mktemp factory directories are not removed after each test; successful sessionfinish can remove an auto-generated base. Explicit basetemp and interrupted/failed sessions can retain it.
installed_pytest_semantics.path_bounds: The factory checks basename resolution remains directly within its owned base, verifies predictable root ownership, and does not permit a symlink root. rmtree of the owned temporary path does not follow child source symlinks.
installed_pytest_semantics.tmp_path_cleanup: During fixture finalization, rmtree only the path created by the factory when policy==failed and call report passed (default True when absent). Dependent fixtures finalize first. A later setup/teardown error does not restore removed files.

limitations: Prior volumes are incomplete core prefixes. The sums are conservative observed directory maxima, not simultaneous measurements or a full-core bound.
Footprints count regular-file allocated blocks with hardlink deduplication within each measured directory, excluding directory inode overhead.
Changing the temporary filesystem changes real free-space readings; application quota and storage guards remain active and may legitimately fail in the bounded trial.

The mounted pytest tmpfs belongs to this one disposable test container; power loss of that container loses its RAM artifacts. Process SIGKILL tests retain kernel data while the client container lives.
mandatory_conditions: Mount only /tmp/pytest-of-swingset with size=768MiB,mode1777,uid10001,gid10001; keep the outer /tmp named volume for real test-run/Copies ledgers, service credentials and reports.

Apply builtin tmp_path_retention_policy=failed to the outer pytest AND inherited ordinary pytest children, including armed acceptance. Preserve existing cache options. Do not propagate unrelated selectors or worker flags.

The isolated historical runner strips ambient pytest options. Either forward only the literal failed-retention policy under the recognized harness setting, or account for its accumulating session-factory group directories in the bounded trial.
Preserve real fsync calls, all crash/cleanup assertions, exact default-core selection and test outcomes.
Retain the 2GiB RAM+swap cap per client and monitor actual cgroup usage/OOM events, tmpfs bytes and inodes. Gracefully stop on exhaustion; do not silently raise limits or drop tests.
Before client exit, durably export retained CALL-failure/interrupted/session data out of tmpfs. Builtin cleanup does not promise artifacts for setup or teardown failures.
reviewer: independent pg_engine agent; launcher owned by pg_dev
scope: Only disposable pytest-owned paths and explicitly marked capacity-fixture allocations in dedicated native Linux test clients; production durability code and source files are unchanged.
verdict: ACCEPT for a bounded measured trial with the mandatory conditions below. This is not proof that the complete core fits the tmpfs bound.
